replies.author: joelous
replies.body:
Hey!
Thanks for submitting your map, we appreciate it! A few suggestions though, the map at the moment seems a bit too linear - that is - there is only one direction a player can go. I see an issue with defending on this map, and will most likely cause stalemates. In addition, rushers are going to struggle to get out of the wool rooms and successfully return the wool to their base. I propose that you add a few more lanes to the side (widen it potentially) and give more areas where players can... well, play!

Note: Please get the download soon! I wish to check it out in detail!
